data.name: 1,2-Dichlorobenzene with Water
measurement_methods: The concentration of the tritiated water in the organic phase was determined by isotopic dilution.
The tritium activities in the tritiated water samples were determined by the acetylene method (1,2).
mixing_methods: Tritiated water was equilibrated with 20 ml 1,2-dichlorobenzene by stirring in a flask in a constant temperature water bath for two hours.

publication_references.citation: Wing, J.; Johnston, W.H., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 1957, 79(4), 864-5.
